findings.summary: Bundled ffprobe in /Applications/BeefTV.app/Contents/Resources/agent-host/media-runtime/ffprobe is compiled without image2/png_pipe/jpeg_pipe/webp_pipe demuxers, causing POST /api/ops/media.overview on image resources and POST /api/assistant/chat with image attachments to fail with HTTP 412 media_probe_failed / HTTP 500 internal_error.

managedImageOptions copies canvas aspect ratio config.Size ('16:9') verbatim into options['size'] = '16:9' instead of normalizing to pixel dimensions ('1536x1024' / '1824x1024'), causing default 16:9 canvas image nodes submitted to gpt-image-2.5 via POST /v1/media/tasks to fail upstream with media_generation_failed.

ShouldDeferImageRecovery unconditionally returns true for any error on a BeefAPI canvas_image task once the image_submissions row exists, even when taskErr is a terminal *beefapi.MediaTaskError (status='failed'), trapping failed image tasks in an infinite 15s polling loop ('正在恢复图片结果') for 23 hours.
ManagedTaskQuery omits StartedAt: time.Now(), causing failureDiagnostics.requests to record startedAt='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z' and durationMs=9223372036854.

Across Round 1 (seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.5) and Round 2 (seedance-2.0), reference video/image uploads (POST /v1/media/uploads -> COS PUT -> POST /v1/media/uploads/complete) succeed with HTTP 200, but POST /v1/media/tasks with operation='reference_to_video' is rejected upstream with HTTP 202 status='failed', error.code='media_submission_rejected', error.category='input' ('The original media request was rejected before a task was created.').

POST /api/assistant/turns/:turnId/proposals/:proposalId/production passes errors from ConfirmAssistantProduction (which returns *operations.Error such as Conflict/PreconditionFailed/InvalidArg) into failService(c, err), which only unwraps *app.ServiceError and therefore maps 409/412/400 *operations.Error into HTTP 500 internal.
